def shade(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color)
    tcPr.append(shd)

TOK = re.compile(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|__.+?__)")
def add_runs(par, text, size=None, bold_all=False):
    for part in TOK.split(text):
        if not part:
            continue
        if part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**"):
            r = par.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
        elif part.startswith("__") and part.endswith("__"):
            r = par.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.italic = True
        else:
            r = par.add_run(part)
            if bold_all: r.bold = True
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)

def para(text, style=None, align=None, size=None, space_after=6, bold_all=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else doc.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, bold_all=bold_all)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    if align == "center": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if align == "justify": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    return p

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, size=9.5, head_fill="1F2A44"):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(size); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
        shade(c, head_fill)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            lines = val.split("\n")
            for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
                p = cells[i].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[i].add_paragraph()
                add_runs(p, ln, size=size)
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
            if i == 0 and len(headers) > 2:
                pass
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def kv_table(rows, widths=(1.45, 5.05), size=9.5, fill="E8ECF3"):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    for k, v in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = ""; cells[1].text = ""
        add_runs(cells[0].paragraphs[0], k, size=size, bold_all=True)
        shade(cells[0], fill)
        for j, ln in enumerate(v.split("\n")):
            p = cells[1].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[1].add_paragraph()
            add_runs(p, ln, size=size)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    for row in t.rows:
        row.cells[0].width = Inches(widths[0]); row.cells[1].width = Inches(widths[1])
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)

for b in BLOCKS:
    kind = b[0]
    if kind == "title":
        para(b[1], align="center", size=14, bold_all=True, space_after=2)
    elif kind == "center":
        para(b[1], align="center", size=10, space_after=2)
    elif kind == "h1":

    elif kind == "num":
